brief:
The Israel lobby maintains significant political sway in the United States as the new year opens, according to the Quincy Institute. Advocacy organizations representing Israeli interests continue to shape U.S. foreign policy discussions and congressional action on Middle East matters.

The lobby's reach extends across political parties and media spheres, enabling it to frame debates around Israeli security and Palestinian issues. Its institutional strength reflects decades of organized effort to align American policy with Israeli government positions.
title: Israel lobby strengthens influence as 2026 begins
